data: A math_counter variant that specializes in vector operations.
The vector this entity shuold start with.
The name that other entities refer to this entity by.

Name by which this entity is linked to another entity in a different map. When the player transitions to a new map, entities in the new map with globalnames matching entities in the previous map will have the previous map's state copied over their state.
This entity's orientation in the world. Roll is the rotation around the X axis, pitch is rotation around the Y axis and yaw is the rotation around the Z axis.
The name of this entity's parent in the movement hierarchy. Entities with parents move with their parent. Set an attachment point via 'parentname,attachment'.
Adds a vector to this entity's current value and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Divides a vector from this entity's current value and fire the OutValue output with the result.
Multiplies a vector from this entity's current value and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Sets this entity's current vector to a new value and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Sets this entity's current vector to a new value without firing any outputs.
Subtracts a vector from this entity's current value and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Causes this entity to fire its OnGetValue output with its current vector. Used for polling the counter when you don't want constant updates from the OutValue output.
Creates an angle pointing from the entity's current vector to the specified point and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Creates an angle pointing from the entity's current vector to the specified entity and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Converts this entity's vector to an angle, assuming the current vector is a direction vector. Fires the OutValue output with the result.
Converts this entity's vector angles to a vector in the forward direction. Fires the OutValue output with the result.
Converts this entity's vector angles to a vector in the right direction. Fires the OutValue output with the result.
Converts this entity's vector angles to a vector in the up direction. Fires the OutValue output with the result.
Normalizes this entity's vector and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Normalizes this entity's vector as angles and fires the OutValue output with the result.
Adds to this entity's X coordinate.
Adds to this entity's Y coordinate.
Adds to this entity's Z coordinate.
Subtracts from this entity's X coordinate.
Subtracts from this entity's Y coordinate.
Subtracts from this entity's Z coordinate.
Removes this entity from the world.
Removes this entity and all its children from the world.
Changes the entity's parent in the movement hierarchy.
Change this entity to attach to a specific attachment point on its parent. Entities must be parented before being sent this input. The parameter passed in should be the name of the attachment.

Change this entity to attach to a specific attachment point on it's parent. Entities must be parented before being sent this input. The parameter passed in should be the name of the attachment. The entity will maintain it's position relative to the parent at the time it is attached.
Removes this entity from the the movement hierarchy, leaving it free to move independently.
Sets the rotation of the entity relative to the parent's rotation.
Sets the position of the entity relative to its parent if one exists. Otherwise relative to the world.
Set this entity's angles, always relative to the world origin.

Adds an entity I/O connection to this entity or changes keyvalues dynamically. Format:
'

:<max times to fire (-1 == infinite, 1 = only once)>'
or 'keyvalue newval'. Very dangerous, use with care.
Causes this entity's OnUser1 output to be fired.
Causes this entity's OnUser2 output to be fired.
Causes this entity's OnUser3 output to be fired.
Causes this entity's OnUser4 output to be fired.
More or less replicates the player interacting with an entity. (+USE)
Causes this entity's OutUser1 output to be fired, passing along the parameter unchanged.
Causes this entity's OutUser2 output to be fired, passing along the parameter unchanged.
Causes this entity's OutUser3 output to be fired, passing along the parameter unchanged.
Causes this entity's OutUser4 output to be fired, passing along the parameter unchanged.
Fires OnUser1, OnUser2, OnUser3, or OnUser4 with a 25% chance of each.
Fires OutUser1, OutUser2, OutUser3, or OutUser4 with a 25% chance of each. The parameter is passed along unchanged.
Removes this entity if it is not in a player's viewcone.
Removes this entity when it is not in a player's viewcone. You can pass a time for when this should start.
Fires the named output on this entity. Format: '
' (OnDeath:hl3cardgame:gaben). Everything beyond the output name is optional.
Removes all instances of the named output on this entity. Wildcards are supported, meaning you could just pass '*' to wipe all outputs from this entity.
Fires the named input on this entity. Format: '
' (SetTarget:cheese). Everything beyond the input name is optional. Mind the fact this is arranged differently from FireOutput, having the parameter right after the input name.
Cancels any events fired by this entity that are currently pending in the I/O event queue.
Unparents all direct children of this entity.
Sets this entity's current angular velocity.
Adds spawnflag(s) to this entity. Many spawnflags have their respective numbers suffixed in this FGD.
Removes spawnflag(s) to this entity. Many spawnflags have their respective numbers suffixed in this FGD.
Adds solid flags to this entity.
Removes solid flags from this entity.
Similar to AddOutput, except it changes an internal variable similar to logic_datadesc_accessor instead. Very dangerous, use with care.
Sets this entity's name that other entities should refer to it by.
Sets this entity's target. This is specific to certain entities, particularly logic entities that involve a target.
Sets this entity's owner entity. This has nothing to do with parenting and has more to do with collision and kill credits.
Sets this entity's general think function to null. Behavior varies from entity to entity..
Simulates this entity touching the specified entity.
Fired when the value changes, passing the resulting X coordinate.
Fired when the value changes, passing the resulting Y coordinate.
Fired when the value changes, passing the resulting Z coordinate.
Fired in response to the GetValue input. Used for polling this entity's current value when you don't want constant updates from the OutValue output.
Fired in response to the GetX input.
Fired in response to the GetY input.
Fired in response to the GetZ input.
Fired in response to FireUser1 input.
Fired in response to FireUser2 input.
Fired in response to FireUser3 input.
Fired in response to FireUser4 input.
Fires in response to PassUser1 input, with the parameter passed through unchanged.
Fires in response to PassUser2 input, with the parameter passed through unchanged.
Fires in response to PassUser3 input, with the parameter passed through unchanged.
Fires in response to PassUser4 input, with the parameter passed through unchanged.
